morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语句子中作为完整专名使用，不作马来语词缀拆分；英语读音中 ph 表示 /f/。is_root 沿用输入包的整词归档标记。

senses.zh_definition: 墨菲：源自爱尔兰的姓氏；具体指称须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: An Irish-origin surname, conventionally capitalized Murphy.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal dari Ireland dan lazimnya dieja Murphy dengan huruf awal besar.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不能据此认定为马来语普通词或 DBP 官方词条。输入缺少原句，姓氏只是可核实的一种解释。音标为英式英语参考读音；中文译名仅供参考。以下搭配为示例，未核实其频率。词源参见 [Irish Names and Surnames](https://www.libraryireland.com/names/om/o-murchadha.php)。

etymology.historical_story: Murphy preserves an Irish family-name tradition rather than a Malay word-building pattern. Woulfe records Ó Murchadha as meaning descendant of Murchadh, with the ancestral name associated with a sea warrior. He describes several distinct families bearing it, so sharing the surname does not establish membership of one single lineage. [Source](https://www.libraryireland.com/names/om/o-murchadha.php)
